articles.title: Sean Payton house: Inside $4.5M, 6,000 sq ft Belcaro mansion with oversized kitchen, primary suite fireplace and elevator where Denver Broncos coach lives with wife Skylene Montgomery
articles.summary: Sean Payton was traded from the New Orleans Saints sidelines to the Denver Broncos franchise along with a 2024 third round draft pick.
articles.body: Sean Payton was traded from the New Orleans Saints sidelines to the Denver Broncos franchise along with a 2024 third round draft pick.The Broncos head coach found himself a mansion in one of the Denver’s most-coveted residential neighborhoods. Belcaro is an established Denver neighborhood known for its upscale residences. He lives in the gated property with his wife, Skylene Montgomery.The 6,000 sq-ft property blends contemporary design with high-end residential features. The two-story home offers four bedrooms and six bathrooms. Its interiors are designed around spacious living rooms, custom finishes, and entertaining spaces.Sean Payton purchased the Belcaro mansion for $4.55 million in March 2023. In June 2026, he signed a five-year deal with the Denver Broncos which is in the neighborhood of $18 million per year, as per NBC Sports’ Peter King.Sean Payton’s Belcaro mansion has oversized kitchen, high ceilings, and custom flooringAs per The Denver Post, Sean Payton’s Belcaro mansion was developed by Raymond Development Group. The gated property features a modern architectural design across two levels.The upscale residence is defined by generous proportions. The main level has 11-foot ceilings. White oak-flooring is laid in a herringbone pattern, thereby adding a refined touch to the living rooms. The mansion’s open layout allows living and entertaining areas to blend into one another, thereby creating a spacious environment throughout the property.The kitchen is what stands out in the mansion. The oversized kitchen features a large central island which acts as an additional preparation space and a gathering spot.A glass wine wall offers a luxury element to the kitchen. The dedicated display and storage area can accommodate hundreds of bottles, thereby offering the kitchen and surrounding entertaining spaces a stunning visual allure.When an oversized kitchen, high ceilings, and custom flooring combine, it offers the upscale residence a polished contemporary character without entirely relying on its square footage.The Belcaro mansion also includes several features designed for quiet privacy and accommodating convenience. The primary suite has its own fireplace and dual closets, thereby creating a comfortable retreat within the two-story mansion.An elevator in the home connects the levels, thereby giving practical luxury features to the detached, single-family luxury home within a gated community.Sean Payton’s New Orleans mansionAs per New Orleans Luxury Living’s Elizabeth McNulty, Sean Payton owned a magnificent Greek Revival mansion in New Orleans while he coached the New Orleans Saints. The property was situated in the best part of Uptown, on an exceptionally rare and oversized corner lot. It was built in 1893.The mansion spanned over 6,060 sq-ft and boasted five bedrooms and six bathrooms. The interiors were curated by famed interior designer Gwen Driscoll. A beautiful foyer led to the formal living and dining rooms.A true chef’s kitchen complete with La Cornue range & hood and oversized satin island with prep-sink effortlessly flew into the sprawling family room. The family room had a gas fireplace and was adjacent to additional covered outdoor living spaces.The sweeping staircase led to three guest suites and a luxurious primary suite. A private primary sanctuary featured French doors with dual bathrooms, dressing area, two walk-in closets, beverage center, gas fireplace, and private balcony with breathtaking views of expansive grounds.Exteriors of the massive property boasted a heated saltwater pool, guest house with wet bar, half bath and private second floor with full kitchen and balcony.The 6,060 sq-ft mansion also featured a media room, gym, additional flex space, two-car garage, generator and state-of-the-art security system to offer ultimate luxury, privacy, and comfort.As per Mansion Global, the property was listed for $3.3 million in October 2024. As per New Orleans Luxury Living’s Elizabeth McNulty, the property was sold in February 2025.Sean Payton’s Saints era and Broncos comebackSean Payton was the head coach for the New Orleans Saints from 2006 to 2021. He won a Super Bowl for them in a victory over the Indianapolis Colts for the 2009 season. However, later, Payton was reportedly suspended for the entire 2012 NFL season because of his involvement in the team’s bounty scandal.A scandal where players were paid bounties for injuring players on opposing teams. Anyhow, he returned and coached the team till the 2021 NFL season. After taking a break from coaching career in 2022, he returned to coaching. But not for the New Orleans Saints but for the Denver Broncos.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: The Vest, Leather Jacket And So Much More: Bears Legend Mike Ditka's NFL Legacy
articles.summary: Mike Ditka is a football icon. A great player, coach and person who impacted NFL society. Here's a look at the Bears' legend's career.
articles.body: One can't tell the story of the NFL without Mike Ditka. The Ditka family announced on Friday afternoon that the Hall of Fame head coach and tight end passed away at 86. With that said, just because the Chicago Bears' legend is no longer physically present in the football world, doesn't mean his legacy won't be felt for eternity. As both a player and coach, Ditka was one of a kind and impacted the sport both on and off the field. Ditka's Historic Tight End Play Before becoming a legend with the Bears vest on his chest, Ditka was a menace at tight end. Originally selected by the Houston Oilers with the No. 8 pick in the 1961 AFL Draft, Ditka, an All-American who finished sixth in the 1960 Heisman Trophy voting with the Pittsburgh Panthers, opted against playing in the upstart AFL. One month later, he was selected by the Bears with the No. 5 pick in the 1961 NFL Draft and packed his bags for the Windy City. Sure, Ditka could drive a defender into the parking lot as a blocker, but "Iron Mike" made history as a pass-catcher. In Ditka's 1961 rookie campaign, he became the first tight end in NFL history to log 1,000 receiving yards in a single season, reeling in 56 receptions for 1,076 yards (19.2 yards per reception) and 12 touchdowns. Ditka would be a Pro Bowler in each of his first five seasons in the sport and an All-Pro in 1963 and 1964. Over his first four seasons (1961-64), Ditka averaged 62.0 receptions for 917.8 yards and 7.5 touchdowns per year. Ditka was part of Chicago's 1963 NFL Championship team, which marked the Bears' first NFL championship since 1946. Following six years with the Bears (1961-66), Ditka spent two years with the Philadelphia Eagles (1967-68) and finished his career with the Dallas Cowboys from 1969-72. On the Dallas front, Ditka helped the Cowboys win their first-ever Super Bowl and championship altogether in 1971, reeling in a 7-yard touchdown from Roger Staubach in the fourth quarter of the team's Super Bowl VI triumph over the Miami Dolphins. Ditka's 80s Bears Ditka parlayed his four seasons with the Cowboys into nine seasons as the assistant head coach and special teams coordinator for Hall of Fame head coach Tom Landry in Dallas from 1973-81. Meanwhile, up north, after posting losing records in three of the previous four seasons, the Bears fired head coach Neill Armstrong in 1982. Seeing an opportunity to both become a head coach and bring his first NFL love back to prominence, Ditka interviewed for the Bears' head-coaching vacancy and ultimately got the job — and would later embark on an indelible journey. The strike-shortened 1982 season, which saw Chicago go 3-6, and a .500 campaign (8-8) in 1983 put Ditka on thin ice. But the Bears found themselves in Year 3 of the Ditka era. As part of a 10-6 season that saw Chicago win its division for the first time since its 1963 NFL Championship season, the Bears reached the NFC Championship Game. After being shut out by Bill Walsh's San Francisco 49ers, who went on to win the Super Bowl, in the NFC title game, Ditka's Bears would put together one of the most dominant seasons in NFL history. In what was a 15-1 regular season — with the mere blemish being a Week 13 loss to Dan Marino and the Dolphins on Monday Night Football — Chicago recorded 70 sacks in 1985, which came after tallying 72 sacks the year prior. The Bears' defense pitched two shutouts in the regular season and held opponents to no more than 10 points in 11 of 16 games. Then, Chicago proceeded to shut out BOTH the New York Giants and Los Angeles Rams in the NFC playoffs before laying waste to the New England Patriots in Super Bowl XX, 46-10. Who did that defense include? For starters, it had four Hall of Famers: defensive end Richard Dent, linebacker Mike Singletary and defensive linemen Steve McMichael and Dan Hampton. Chicago's defense also had Pro Bowl linebackers Otis Wilson and Wilber Marshall and "The Fridge," defensive lineman William Perry, who, of course, would occasionally get the call on the run — or in the air — on offense. All the while, the Bears had Leslie Frazier, Gary Fencik, Dave Duerson, Mike Richardson and Ken Taylor, who combined for 23 interceptions in their secondary. The '80s Bears, specifically the 1985 Bears, have an argument for being the best defense ever assembled. As for the other side of the ball, Chicago leaned on one of the best running backs in NFL history in Walter Payton, with Hall of Fame left tackle Jimbo Covert and perennial Pro Bowlers Jay Hilgenberg and Mark Bortz leading the way up front. Meanwhile, Ditka had the ever-confident Jim McMahon under center. While the Bears never returned to the Super Bowl after the 1985 season under Ditka, they won 14 games in 1986 despite the departure of defensive coordinator Buddy Ryan, who became the head coach of the Philadelphia Eagles, and made the playoffs and won double-digit games in seven of Ditka's 12 seasons at the helm (1982-92). Ditka's Cultural Impact Everybody knows or has seen somebody who wears a Harley-Davidson-looking leather jacket. But for Bears fans, that was just their beloved head coach. Dark jacket. Dark glasses. A boisterous face. Never satisfied. That was the vibe Ditka portrayed on the Bears' sideline. And if he wasn't in leather, he was rocking the signature Bears vest that countless fans are seen wearing at Soldier Field and across the country. Meanwhile, in the wake of the team's Super Bowl triumph and consistent playoff presence, Chicago's players and coaches became prominent public figures. Yeah, Ditka wasn't in "The Super Bowl Shuffle," but he did inspire one of the most memorable skits in "Saturday Night Live" history, that being "Bill Swerski's Super Fans," which is based on multiple Chicago "super fans" revering the Bears' head coach at the pub "Ditka's." Ditka also starred in the 2005 movie "Kicking & Screaming," with him serving as a coach for Will Ferrell's character's son's soccer team. Ditka's NFL Standing Ditka is tied with George Halas for first in Bears' history with six playoff victories and is second in franchise history with 106 regular-season wins. In all, Ditka, who was also the head coach of the New Orleans Saints from 1997-99, is 34th among head coaches in NFL history with 121 regular-season wins and is tied with Dennis Green for 32nd with 12 career playoff game appearances. Meanwhile, as a player, Ditka is fourth in Bears' history with 34 receiving touchdowns, fifth with 4,503 receiving yards and sixth with 316 receptions. Some people are great players. Others are great coaches. Mike Ditka was both.

articles.title: Prayers Pour in From Brittany Mahomes & Well-Wishers as Ex-Chiefs Star's Wife Shares Heartbreaking Message Months After Tragedy
articles.summary: Former Kansas City Chiefs guard Jordan Devey was only 38 years old when he died on July 21, 2026. He left behind a loving wife, Linsey, and four young childr...
articles.body:
Former Kansas City Chiefs guard Jordan Devey was only 38 years old when he died on July 21, 2026. He left behind a loving wife, Linsey, and four young children. Months later, Linsey shared a heartbreaking post remembering her late husband.

The picture Linsey posted showed her holding her daughters tightly in an emotional moment. The long caption that followed traced what she is going through, being the pillar for her four children, as they lost their dad, who meant so much to them.

"There are so many pictures where my eyes are closed. When I look at them, I see a mom praying—asking Heavenly Father for the strength to keep going, keep loving, and keep showing up for my babies. ???? How do you explain mental illness to an 11, 8, 4, and 2-year-old?" Linsey wrote. "That Dad's broken brain was not the same thing as Dad's heart. That we can hold his mental illness in one hand and his heart in the other.

"Jordan had so many struggles, but they never dictated the way he loved. He loved BIG. He coached, served, ministered, and showed up for people. His struggles never changed the size of his heart."

The Chiefs community showed up to support Linsey. Among them was Brittany Mahomes, quarterback Patrick Mahomes' wife.

"Praying so hard for you and your family! You are strong, you can do this ????????????????," wrote Brittany in the comment section of the October 2 post.

Devey had a short stint playing for the Kansas City Chiefs, being with the team from 2016 to 2018. He had been a journeyman, spent time on practice rosters, and saw very little action on the field. Across seven seasons, Jordan played in 44 NFL games, including 21 starts, while representing five franchises: New England, San Francisco, Kansas City, Las Vegas/Oakland, and Buffalo.

Devey's mother, Leslie, told FOX 13 that the family believed Jordan suffered from chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), a condition very commonly associated with NFL players now.

"We believe the possibility of that was very true, simply because he had signs and symptoms," Leslie Devey told KUTV. "And the fact of the brutal beatings that he's taken over the years playing on the field, but also during practice."

Fans are now standing as a pillar of support for Linsey during this tough time. They left uplifting messages for the mother of four in the comments.

"You are a force, girl. This is what leaning into Christ looks like. I love you so much. Thank you so much for being open about this. You are helping so many who struggle with their own mental health. We are praying right along with you," wrote a fan.

"Your words are powerful and so beautiful, @ldevey," another fan wrote. "It feels to me like you found perfect words… Praying for you all. Praying for Jordan too."

"I'm so very sorry," read another comment. "Faith will carry you through this. The longing doesn't fade but you'll still see glimmers of light, hope, purpose and love. I pray for the ultimate comforter our Lord Jesus Christ. God bless you and keep you."

"We love you and your family. Always in our prayers and hearts. Your strength is exemplary," a fan wrote.

"Your Kansas City & Chiefs family is always here to celebrate the incredible Christ-filled heart of #65. May God Bless you, and the many hands and hearts helping you all heal," another message read.

In real life, Devey was a fighter. His football journey to the NFL was unconventional, as he did not play football in high school. He'd spent enough years in the league and was having fun, based on what Leslie told KING 5 News. Unfortunately, the family had to suffer the pain of losing Devey so early.

articles.title: Is Shedeur Sanders single? Browns backup QB goes on blind date as Deshaun Watson grabs gridiron duties
articles.summary: The Cleveland Browns chose old hero Deshaun Watson as their starting quarterback.
articles.body: The Cleveland Browns chose old hero Deshaun Watson as their starting quarterback. So, their 2025 fifth-round pick, Shedeur Sanders, hasn’t gotten a chance to start even a single game.But that doesn’t leave his off-field presence out of focus. He’s attracting significant attention while staying away from the gridiron, especially after going on a date with a Cosmopolitan interviewer.The 144th overall pick opened up about his relationship preferences and approach to finding a partner. The interview comes at a crucial time, as he occupies a backup role in Cleveland.Sanders, the son of Pro Football Hall of Famer Deion Sanders, has called himself legendary for the longest time, but his first NFL franchise clearly doesn’t want to give him any playing time. So, what does he do? He makes the most of his off-field time. He goes on a date with an interviewer by appearing on Cosmopolitan’s “Blind Date” series.As of October 10, 2026, Sanders hasn’t publicly confirmed being in a relationship. His Cosmopolitan interview reveals that he’s “extremely picky” about relationships and has clear standards for welcoming someone new into his life.Shedeur Sanders reveals his ideal partner’s must have qualities and relationships standardsShedeur Sanders previously addressed love-life questions in February 2025. During a “2Legendary” podcast appearance, Sanders was asked whether he had any special woman in his life. He playfully answered that question by saying, “Yes, I have my mom [Pilar Sanders].”Cut to present, more than a year and a half later, Sanders’ girlfriend status still remains unclear as ever. During his conversation with Cosmopolitan Editor-in-Chief Willa Bennett, Sanders discussed his standards for a potential partner. He said he wants his partner to be “hard working” and that her “mentality” would be attractive to him.When Bennett stressed on the mentality part, Sanders explained that he’d want to know “what’s the healthy amount of vacation time” from his partner.He’d want his partner to be fully present during a vacation. And not be posting on Instagram or any other social media platform. He values vacation time and wants to be “mentally free” at that moment. As for what he’d want to be the first thing to be noticed about him on the first date, he’d want it to be his “smile.”Shedeur Sanders values longterm relationshipsShedeur Sanders recently appeared on the Cosmo Centerfold series of Cosmopolitan, where the hottest celebs of our time are featured.The 24-year-old Cleveland Browns quarterback revealed that he’s extremely picky about who he brings into his family because he’s extremely protective of his family, of the people he loves. He doesn’t want someone who is a superfan, or someone who is more interested in the NFL WAG lifestyle.“I got that question during the draft - how do I feel about WAGs,” Sanders shared.“Some coaches and people didn’t understand what I was saying. But how can I expect them to understand what I’m saying? I’m second-generation. So I look at a lot of things differently. It’s a different type of pressure. It’s a different type of attention. You’re gonna get it when you’re dating me.”So, what is the pathway towards dating Sanders? “Let’s truly be friends first. I don’t plan on dying anytime soon. I’m in it for the long game. A lot of people like to rush too quickly,” he said.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.body: Randi Mahomes may have another surprise in store for Kansas City Chiefs fans, and her latest social media post has given them a date to watch. Patrick Mahomes’ mother has sparked interest with a collection of fashion inspiration, Chiefs colours and designs that hint at a possible new apparel project. While she has yet to reveal the full details, October 15, 2026, stands out as a potential milestone. The timing also comes as Brittany Mahomes continues to explore Chiefs-inspired fashion, giving fans another reason to follow the family’s growing presence beyond the football field.Randi Mahomes hints at a new Chiefs fashion collectionRandi has built a connection with Chiefs fans through clothing that brings team spirit into everyday style. Her latest Instagram post adds to that story, offering a glimpse of what could be her next fashion venture.The preview features sweatshirts, T-shirts and a denim jacket decorated with rhinestones. Red-and-black fabric, gold star details and clothing sketches also appear in the mix. A photograph of Patrick wearing his No. 15 jersey adds a personal touch to the display.Rather than spelling out her plans, Randi chose to keep followers guessing. She spoke about the excitement of watching an idea develop and ended her caption with a short promise: “More tomorrow.”The date, 10.15.26, has attracted particular attention. However, Randi has not confirmed whether it marks a product launch, a formal announcement or another development in the project. Fans will have to wait for more information before they can know what the collection will include.There is some history behind the speculation. In October 2025, Randi introduced an eight-piece game-day collection with Gameday Couture. The range included jackets, sweatshirts and T-shirts designed for women who wanted to support their team without sacrificing personal style.She also has an existing collection with Texas True Threads, featuring designs such as “Mahomes 15” and “Kansas City Retro.” These earlier projects show that the latest teaser fits into an established interest in Chiefs apparel.Brittany Mahomes builds her own Chiefs fashion presenceRandi is not the only member of the Mahomes family exploring fan fashion. Brittany, Patrick's wife, introduced another Chiefs-themed collection through her Amazon partnership in December 2025.Her work and Randi's projects reflect the popularity of clothing that allows fans to express their loyalty outside the stadium. Game-day outfits have become part of the wider fan experience, combining team colours with casual wear and individual style.Still, there is no confirmed evidence that the two women are competing for the same audience. Their projects can appeal to different shoppers, and each has room to develop her own approach.For now, important details about Randi's next venture remain unknown. articles.title: Travis Kelce issues a warning to the NFL as Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs dominate
articles.summary: Travis Kelce is not ready to celebrate just yet, even as the Kansas City Chiefs continue to build momentum in the 2026 NFL season.
articles.body: Travis Kelce is not ready to celebrate just yet, even as the Kansas City Chiefs continue to build momentum in the 2026 NFL season. Four games into the campaign, Kansas City remains undefeated, and its veteran tight end has made it clear that the team believes its best football is still ahead. Kelce recently shared a message on social media that caught the attention of Chiefs fans. With Patrick Mahomes leading the offence and new weapons making an impact, Kansas City has plenty of reasons to feel confident as the competition grows tougher.Travis Kelce sends a bold message after the Chiefs' 4-0 startKelce offered a glimpse into the Chiefs' mindset through his Instagram Stories on October 9. He reposted a collection of photographs shared by wide receiver Xavier Worthy, including one featuring Kelce, Mahomes and Worthy together on the field.The tight end added four words that captured the team's confidence: “Just the beginning!!”The message arrived after Kansas City completed a challenging opening stretch with four consecutive victories. Rather than treating the unbeaten record as a reason to relax, Kelce's words suggested that the team sees its early success as a starting point.That attitude could matter as the season develops. Winning close games often tests a team's composure, and the Chiefs have already had to find ways to finish tight contests against the Indianapolis Colts, Miami Dolphins and Las Vegas Raiders.Kansas City opened its season with a commanding win over the Denver Broncos before navigating those tougher matchups. The results have kept the Chiefs unbeaten, but the team will need to maintain that level of focus against stronger opponents.Patrick Mahomes and Kenneth Walker III strengthen the Chiefs' title hopesMahomes remains central to Kansas City's ambitions. Against Las Vegas in Week 4, the quarterback threw for 225 yards and two touchdowns, helping the Chiefs secure another victory.Running back Kenneth Walker III also delivered a standout performance. He rushed for 177 yards and two touchdowns on 22 carries, giving Kansas City another major threat on offence.That combination could make the Chiefs harder to defend. Opponents must account for Mahomes' passing ability while also preparing for Walker's power and speed on the ground. Kelce's presence adds another reliable option for an offence that can attack in several ways.There is still work to do, particularly on defence. Kansas City ranks 12th in total defence, although its run defence sits fifth in the league. Improving consistency across all areas will be important if the team hopes to turn its strong start into a deep playoff run.The Chiefs have a bye in Week 5, giving them time to rest and prepare for their next test. They return in Week 6 against the Los Angeles Chargers.Kelce's message reflects the team's current outlook: four wins are encouraging, but they do not guarantee anything. Kansas City has established an early advantage. Now, the challenge is to keep it going.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: “Don’t let other people’s ideas get to you”: Patrick Mahomes’ wife Brittany Mahomes offers advice to first time mothers ahead of Week 5
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes, the Kansas City Chiefs’ star player, has been a force to be reckoned with on the field as his wife, Brittany Mahomes, has been a strong
articles.body: Patrick Mahomes, the Kansas City Chiefs’ star player, has been a force to be reckoned with on the field as his wife, Brittany Mahomes, has been a strong pillar of strength and support to him. While Brittany Mahomes has also carved her own career and runs multiple ventures, she has also remained a dedicated mother to their three children. Amid this, Brittany Mahomes has a piece of advice for young mothers.Patrick Mahomes’ wife Brittany Mahomes reflects on motherhood as she gives advice to young mothersIn a recent social media post, Patrick Mahomes’ wife Brittany Mahomes reflected on her oldest daughter, Sterling, as she said, “Just a little emotional today thinking about how blessed I am and how proud of this little angel I am. She has been doing so good as a big sister.”The Kansas City Currents co-owner added, “She loves her brother so much & has been just the best little helper!!🤍 I felt like so many people were trying to put this negative idea of how much she was gonna hate not being the only child into my head & it was kind of starting to upset me…”Patrick Mahomes’ wife Brittany Mahomes continued, “If you are a new mom, or about to become a mama of multiple kiddos, just know everyone’s story is different & don’t let other people’s ideas get to you! It’s your family & your own journey. It will all workout, stay positive and enjoy every second of it🙏🏼🤍…”The popular investor added, “I think for me it was just still learning to make time for yourself and other stuff and not just solely your child!” Brittany wrote. “Life is still moving when you have a kiddo so obviously they become your main priority but you can’t just forget about everything else you did before…”Patrick Mahomes has often reflected on Brittany Mahomes’ dedication towards motherhood and how she has supported himOver the last few years, the Kansas City Chiefs’ quarterback Patrick Mahomes has often expressed gratitude to his wife, Brittany Mahomes, for being there for their three children when he remains busy with his career on the field.Interestingly, Patrick Mahomes’ wife Brittany Mahomes is spotted at almost all the matches of the Kansas City Chiefs and is often spotted cheering on her husband and trolling the haters.Last year, just days after she gave birth to their youngest daughter, Golden Raye, Patrick Mahomes’ wife Brittany Mahomes was spotted being there for her husband as many trolled her for not giving her body enough time to recover.The popular investor kept herself from all the negativity as she focused on supporting her husband.As Week 5 approaches, all eyes remain on Patrick Mahomes.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Caleb Williams Injury Update, Latest Return Timeline for Bears QB Ahead of NFL Week 5
articles.summary: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams "could return sometime in the next several weeks," according to The Ringer's Tom Pelissero.
articles.body:
Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams "could return sometime in the next several weeks," according to The Ringer's Tom Pelissero .

Williams practiced Friday on a limited basis, with the Bears listing him as questionable in Week 5.

Still, Pelissero suggested Chicago is willing to be patient with his recovery. The NFL insider cited the Bears' next two games (Oct. 18 against the Atlanta Falcons and Oct. 22 against the New England Patriots) as possible occasions for him to be activated.

They'll have a long turnaround between Weeks 7 and 8, 11 days, which would afford Williams more time to recuperate and sharpen up if he needs it.

The third-year signal-caller began his 2026 season with an explosive performance during a 59-37 win over the Carolina Panthers, throwing for 269 yards and two touchdowns while adding 65 rushing yards and two more scores.

Unfortunately, Williams suffered a Grade 2 right hamstring strain while he was running for the end zone in the fourth quarter of the Bears' Week 2 game against the Minnesota Vikings (9-3 loss). Williams fell to the ground on the six-yard line on a non-contact play and was stretchered off the field.

ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reported on Sept. 27 that the injury could sideline him for "three-to-four weeks."

The Bears selected Williams, a former Oklahoma and USC star, with the No. 1 overall pick in the 2024 NFL draft. He and the Bears broke out in 2025, the first season under head coach Ben Johnson. Chicago won the NFC North and reached the NFC Divisional round thanks in part due to Williams' late-game heroics. He ended up throwing for 3,942 passing yards and 27 touchdowns.

Without Williams, Tyson Bagent is the team's interim starter, and Case Keenum is the backup.

Keenum starred in Week 3 against the Philadelphia Eagles in a 27-7 win after Bagent missed most of practice leading to the game ( concussion protocol ). He finished with 247 passing yards and two touchdowns. Bagent took over the following week and led the Bears to a 23-12 win (268 passing yards).

articles.title: “Small actions make a huge impact”: A.J. Brown Foundation’s $20K gift cards, 100 bicycles, and $11K Chickie’s & Pete’s donation
articles.summary: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown is currently not playing but is recovering from a high right ankle sprain.
articles.body: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown is currently not playing but is recovering from a high right ankle sprain. He got injured in the first game of the first season with a new team. In the meantime, his philanthropic work may keep him busy as he recovers and works towards a gridiron return.The former Philadelphia Eagles star is extending his powerful impact beyond football. He uses his valuable platform to support children and families through the A.J. Brown Foundation. The foundation’s efforts have included fundraising initiatives, educational support, holiday gifts, and community partnerships.A.J. Brown Foundation expands youth education and development opportunitiesThe A.J. Brown organization’s heartwarming efforts reflect its commitment to helping young people access opportunities that can shape their futures. Apart from promoting literacy, the foundation provides scholarships, organizes youth sports camps, and offers resources for academic achievement.Launched in 2023, the foundation focuses on youth development, literacy advocacy, and mental health awareness. According to CAA Speakers, the foundation’s charitable work also includes educational opportunities for underserved students.The organization announced a scholarship program in 2024 to support post-secondary education. In February 2026, the foundation partnered with Boys Latin Charter School to offer a scholarship to two student athletes.$11K donation supports PhiladelphiaA.J. Brown Foundation has benefited from corporate partnerships too in bringing its community-focused mission to life. Chickie’s & Pete’s $11,000 donation highlights Brown’s charitable work, thereby demonstrating how business support can contribute to initiatives serving local families.Fans, food, and the Philadelphia community made the donation possible. The check was awarded at the Chickie’s & Pete’s South Philly location.A.J. took a moment to thank the team, the fans, and the Chickie’s & Pete’s family for helping bring more awareness and resources to his foundation. Chickie’s & Pete’s also launched a seasonal “Sweet Heat” wing flavor inspired by A.J. Brown.Brown’s community impact also earned him recognition beyond individual donations.NBC Philadelphia reported that the NFL wide receiver received the first-ever Making a Better Philly Changemaker Award, thereby acknowledging his positive impact in the region. articles.title: Rob Parker delivers harsh verdict on undefeated Minnesota Vikings after their offense fails to score touchdowns in two wins
articles.summary: The Minnesota Vikings are 4-0 to start the 2026 NFL season, but sports commentator Rob Parker is far from impressed.
articles.body: The Minnesota Vikings are 4-0 to start the 2026 NFL season, but sports commentator Rob Parker is far from impressed. Speaking on FOX Sports Radio’s The Odd Couple, Parker called Minnesota the “worst 4-0 team in the history of the NFL,” pointing to its weak offense and two wins without a touchdown. Despite their perfect record, the Vikings still have serious questions to answer before they can be seen as genuine Super Bowl contenders.Rob Parker slams Minnesota Vikings’ offense despite their 4-0 NFL recordDuring his appearance on FOX Sports Radio’s The Odd Couple, Rob Parker made it clear that Minnesota’s winning record has not changed his view of the team. He compared the Vikings with the 2020 Pittsburgh Steelers, who started that season 11-0 but struggled to convince him they were a dominant side.“Do you remember the Pittsburgh Steelers? They were the worst 11-0 team I ever saw in the NFL. And now the Minnesota Vikings are the worst 4-0 team in the history of the NFL,” Parker said.He then turned his attention to Minnesota’s offense, which has struggled to produce touchdowns consistently despite the team winning all four games.“Their offense is putrid. They’re not going anywhere with this. They’ve gotten fortunate... They got lucky. Two games they’ve won without a touchdown. What is this? P**-wee football? Can you please explain to me how the worst offensive football team, for the most part, right? And they’re 4-0 doing it in fugly style because they are fugly.”Parker’s criticism comes as the Vikings deal with injuries to key receiver Justin Jefferson and several offensive linemen. Those absences have made it harder for the team to build a steady attack, even with quarterback Kyler Murray leading the offense after joining Minnesota in the offseason.The Vikings showed what their offense could do in Week 1, scoring 39 points against the Green Bay Packers. However, their performances against the Chicago Bears in Week 2 and the Miami Dolphins in Week 4 raised concerns, as Minnesota won both games without scoring an offensive touchdown.Minnesota Vikings make NFL history with two wins without an offensive touchdownWhile Rob Parker has questioned Minnesota’s quality, the team has achieved something rarely seen in NFL history. According to the supplied report, the Vikings became the first team since the 1934 Detroit Lions to start a season 4-0 after winning two games without scoring an offensive touchdown.Only four teams have managed this feat. They are the 1922 Chicago Cardinals, the 1923 Chicago Cardinals, the 1934 Detroit Lions and the 2026 Minnesota Vikings.Their 9-3 victory over the Chicago Bears in Week 2 came through three field goals from kicker Will Reichard. Minnesota followed that performance with a 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 4, with Reichard making five field goals to help secure another victory.These results show how much the Vikings have depended on their defense and special teams. When the offense has failed to reach the end zone, those units have kept opponents from taking advantage and given Minnesota enough points to win.However, the team cannot depend on field goals alone throughout the season. Its next challenge will be finding a better balance between defense and offense, especially as the competition becomes tougher. Minnesota is scheduled to visit the New Orleans Saints on Sunday, giving the team another chance to show whether its attack can improve.Parker's comments highlight the gap between an unbeaten record and convincing performances. The Vikings have earned their four wins, but their offensive struggles explain why some observers remain doubtful about their chances of making a deep playoff run.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. informed he's being traded as Cardinals seek a second-round pick in return
articles.summary: Marvin Harrison Jr. was told the Arizona Cardinals are finalizing a trade, with the Texans, Chiefs, Eagles and Bills among teams pursuing him.
articles.body: Marvin Harrison Jr.'s time with the Arizona Cardinals is coming to an end after it began only three seasons ago as a first-round draft pick with a Hall of Fame pedigree and high expectations. The team has informed Harrison it is finalizing a deal to trade him and he will be inactive for Sunday's game against the Detriot Lions, ESPN first reported and OutKick has confirmed. Harrison was not initially told what team he'd be traded to, perhaps, one NFL source said, because the Cardinals were open to the idea of having the news leak, and then other teams would raise their trade offers for Harrison. CARDINALS' MARVIN HARRISON JR LOOKS ENTIRELY DISINTERESTED AS SEASON GETS OFF TO A PUTRID START But he's definitely going somewhere else. Harrison, the son of Hall of Famer Marvin Harrison, was the fourth player taken in the 2024 NFL Draft ahead of multiple starting quarterbacks and more productive players such as Brock Bowers, but he has fallen out of favor over the last year as his production declined, his effort and even body language around the team has been questioned and other teams showed interest in acquiring him. CAN MARVIN HARRISON JR. AND TREY MCBRIDE CARRY THE CARDINALS OFFENSE UNDER NEW COACH MIKE LAFLEUR? New coach Mike LaFleur had defended Harrison's effort, saying, "I don’t see it that way. I think his running style is different than some other people’s," while adding that other players had increasingly more defined roles in an offense with limited weekly plays. LaFleur also said some opportunities for Harrison have been eliminated because defensive coverages have dictated he not get the ball while Arizona’s own subpar quarterback play also hasn't helped. The problem with that is the Cardinals have had great receivers who have dealt with similar issues and they were very much valued. Hall of Famer Larry Fitzgerald comes to mind. Except Fitzgerald was never inconsistent in his pass catching while Harrison has struggled with drops. And Fitzgerald simply played hard – all the time. Harrison? It's a lingering question. Rumors of a possible Harrison trade have persisted for weeks, fed by the fact he is eligible for a contract extension after this season and the Cardinals may not be convinced Harrison is worthy of a big contract. Also, Michael Wilson has emerged as a more productive receiver while Harrison currently ranks only fifth on the team in targets. General manager Monti Ossenfort said on Oct. 9 that Harrison "is a big part of what we’re doing," suggesting the team is still more interested in fixing his situation than moving him. Nope. Harrison Jr. wasn't immediately a bust after being drafted out of Ohio State. His rookie season showed both his talent and some inconsistency, but he finished with 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns. The Cardinals expected a Year 2 jump from Harrison. That never came and didn't come this season, either. Multiple teams have contacted the Cardinals about Harrison. The Houston Texans have, the Kansas City Chiefs have, as have the Philadelphia Eagles, Buffalo Bills, New England Patriots, and even the San Francisco 49ers – although that last one is a long shot considering they play in the same division with the Cardinals. The Cardinals have been seeking a package that included a second-round pick in return for Harrison. And this is how bad teams stay bad: The Cardinals are essentially trading a 2024 first round pick for a second-rounder (maybe) years later after getting little in return for their initial investment. articles.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. was an elite prospect and didn't even last three seasons in Arizona before he was traded
articles.summary: Marvin Harrison never broke out for the Cardinals and now he's on the move.
articles.body:
Marvin Harrison Jr. was one of the best wide receiver prospects ever.

That's why, even though he didn't work out for teams before the 2024 NFL Draft, he was still picked fourth overall by the Arizona Cardinals. The first three picks were Caleb Williams, Jayden Daniels and Drake Maye, all franchise quarterbacks off to remarkable starts to their pro careers.

There was no way Harrison was going to fall flat in Arizona … until he did. On Saturday, ESPN reported Harrison will be traded after Sunday's games. When it was reported, it wasn't certain which team Harrison was going to and for what compensation, only that Harrison's career in Arizona was done.

Of all the possible outcomes for Harrison's NFL career, being done with the Cardinals and shipped off after just 33 games for far less than Arizona invested in him was practically unthinkable.

The can't-miss prospect missed, somehow. At least in his first NFL stop.

Marvin Harrison Jr. was an elite prospect

Harrison was a phenomenal college player. In 2022 he had 1,263 yards and 14 touchdowns. Then his quarterback, C.J. Stroud, went to the NFL. And in 2023 Harrison had 1,211 yards for 14 touchdowns.

It's not like Harrison was dominating bad competition. He had two 100-yard games against Michigan. He had 185 yards and then 162 against Penn State. In a bowl game against Georgia he had 102 yards and two touchdowns. He was facing high-level competition and putting up ridiculous production.

Harrison not working out at the combine or in any drills was unusual, but the results at Ohio State were so good it didn't matter. Maybe it should have. When the Cardinals picked Harrison, no reasonable draft analyst was against it. He was widely considered the top non-quarterback in that draft class.

Then the results never came. He had a respectable 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie, though 130 yards and two touchdowns came in one game against the Rams and that proved to be an outlier. That was in Harrison's second game, and over the rest of his Cardinals career he had just one 100-yard game.

In Harrison's second season, when he was out due to injury, Michael Wilson had three 100-yard games and another with 99. Wilson simply looked better in the offense than the platinum prospect out of Ohio State, which was alarming. Harrison had just 608 yards and four touchdowns in 12 games last season. A new coaching staff came in. Wilson signed a three-year, $75 million contract extension in September, a sign of how much the Cardinals valued him.

And when Harrison started the season slowly, it seemed clear that he could get traded. There were just no signs that a breakout was coming.

Harrison had one catch through two games this season. A video of his routes, in which he wasn't explosive or just not playing hard enough, went viral.

The player who didn't run for scouts before the combine couldn't separate. The superstar in college who routinely put up 100 yards was the fourth option, at best, in the Cardinals' offense. He finished this season for Arizona, assuming the trade goes through, with five catches for 85 yards.

Harrison could still emerge as a good NFL receiver. He's 24 years old. It went sour in Arizona but sometimes a trade wakes up a player. Perhaps he'll do better in his new home. The reasons he was a great prospect still exist, though it's hard to remember those traits after his mediocrity with the Cardinals.

It can still happen for Harrison, but it will happen somewhere else if it does. When Arizona drafted Harrison, the Cardinals celebrated. They couldn't figure that they'd be throwing in the towel before Harrison's third season was half over.

articles.title: Cardinals reportedly finalizing deal to trade Marvin Harrison Jr.
articles.summary: No Harrison trade will be completed until after Sunday's games are played, but the wideout's run in Arizona is done, according to multiple reports.
articles.body:
The Arizona Cardinals are reportedly finalizing a deal to trade 2024 No. 4 overall pick Marvin Harrison Jr.

No Harrison trade will be completed until after Sunday's games are played, but the wideout's run in Arizona is done, according to Saturday reports from ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. Harrison will reportedly be inactive this weekend when the Cardinals host the Detroit Lions for a Week 5 matchup.

But the acquiring team has not yet been reported. NFL insider Jordan Schultz reported Saturday that the teams involved in the exchange would "prefer the trade destination is not announced" until both teams play this weekend.

One team that's engaged in trade talks with Arizona surrounding Harrison is the Houston Texans, per Schefter and Rapoport . Texans quarterback C.J. Stroud established an impeccable rapport with Harrison at Ohio State, where Stroud developed into a two-time Heisman Trophy finalist and the 2023 No. 2 overall pick.

Schefter noted in his Saturday reporting , however, that one Texans source told him, regarding the team's interest in Harrison, "I can't confirm or deny at this time."

The Indianapolis Colts, the team for which Harrison's Pro Football Hall of Fame father starred, aren't the franchise finalizing a trade for the third-year pro, according to ESPN's Stephen Holder . The Colts, though, were legitimately interested, per Holder .

The Cardinals were reportedly asking for a second-round pick and more in return for Harrison in trade talks, per The Ringer's Tom Pelissero .

Schefter reported a couple hours later that Arizona told inquiring teams that it wanted first-round value in return for Harrison.

"Arizona is now comfortable enough with whatever offer it has received to make Harrison inactive on Sunday," Schefter wrote in his report on X .

Rumors of a potential trade have heated up in recent weeks following Harrison's slow start to the 2026 campaign. A former Heisman finalist, Harrison has amassed a meager 5-85-1 stat line this season and is averaging just 21.3 receiving yards per game with a career-low 38.5% catch rate.

While Harrison's struggled to live up to his billing so far in his professional career, another Cardinals wide receiver has found his stride. Michael Wilson, a 2023 third-rounder, had a breakout campaign last season, with 78 catches for 1,006 receiving yards and seven touchdowns, second on the team to All-Pro tight end Trey McBride. Wilson was rewarded with a three-year, $75 million contract extension this offseason.

Wilson currently leads a 1-3 Arizona team with 258 receiving yards. Harrison, meanwhile, has been targeted a head-scratching 13 times, as many as rookie running back Jeremiyah Love, according to Pro Football Reference . Harrison clocked out with one reception in both the season opener and last week's loss to the New York Giants, although he scored his lone touchdown in that game. He finished with zero catches in a Week 2 blowout loss to the Seattle Seahawks. His most success under first-year head coach Mike LaFleur was in Week 3, when he reeled in three passes for 40 yards in a setback against the San Francisco 49ers.

The thought was that perhaps a change in offensive scheme could maximize the skill set of the 6-foot-3, 220-pound Harrison. After all, he hardly enjoyed consistent production under former Cardinals offensive coordinator Drew Petzing, who's now in his first season as the Lions' OC. At one point, Marvin Harrison Sr. even aired out his frustration about Arizona's offense .

With Petzing calling the shots, Harrison Jr.'s limited involvement was a frequent talking point during Harrison's first two seasons in the league. So was the on-field connection between then-quarterback Kyler Murray and Harrison, a dynamic that stuttered and flummoxed occasionally. Not coming back to the ball at times or not high-pointing it at others didn't help Harrison's cause. Untimely drops also haunted him, most notably one that turned into a Seahawks interception during Arizona's early-season "Thursday Night Football" defeat last year.

But even with Murray and Petzing gone, Harrison hasn't taken off in the desert. Actually, his role has shriveled up.

Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett is clearly in lockstep with Wilson, and McBride has accrued a team-high 46 targets through four games, whereas Harrison has often appeared to be an afterthought in the LaFleur offense.

Harrison told reporters this week that he wasn't paying attention to the trade speculation.

Yet it's important to point out that Harrison hired a pair of agents on Sept. 23 — he previously didn't have an agent — three days after he went without a catch against the Seahawks, according to ESPN , which cited the NFLPA online database.

Harrison reportedly hired that representation to navigate a possible trade. While the Cardinals already paid Harrison his $22.5 million signing bonus, per ESPN, whichever team acquires him will have to decide on his fifth-year option this coming offseason.

Despite Harrison's underwhelming numbers in Arizona, he isn't far removed from a remarkable college career with the Buckeyes. Plus, he's teased his tantalizing talent with the Cardinals. As a rookie in 2024, he caught 62 passes for 885 yards and eight touchdowns. His sophomore campaign was adversely affected by injuries, but he mounted 608 receiving yards and four scores across 12 games in a season he ended on IR .

A change of scenery could be what Harrison needs to realize his potential, or at least play a bigger role in Year 3 of his NFL career.

articles.title: Arizona Cardinals “finalizing details” to trade Marvin Harrison Jr., per reports
articles.summary: Could Brandon Beane and the Buffalo Bills be working to finalize a deal that pairs Marvin Harrison Jr. with Josh Allen?
articles.body:
The drama surrounding Arizona Cardinals wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. continues. After rampant speculation about the potential for him to be traded just as the 2026 NFL season began, ESPN senior NFL insiders Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport have both reported that the Cardinals' front office is, indeed, finalizing a deal to trade Harrison to a new team.

A tweet by @UnderdogNFL states that "Cardinals and Texans have engaged in 'deep' negotiations for Marvin Harrison Jr. in exchange for 'significant draft capital," while adding that "Cardinals informed Texans they are still listening to potential offers from other teams with hopes of receiving 1st-round draft choice." That report goes on to state that "Several teams have reached out with interest in acquiring Harrison, although at least one team feels Harrison is worth a Day 2 pick."

That's essentially it for the latest news on Harrison, which won't end speculation about his next stop. There are no concrete reports linking the Buffalo Bills and Harrison at this juncture. But it's reasonable to believe that the Bills could be among the mix of teams looking to negotiate a trade for Harrison.

However, there is a bit of heat around him heading to the Houston Texans, with both Schefter and Rapoport saying that talks have happened . That's likely to be true of many teams, including the Indianapolis Colts. Those sources would neither "confirm or deny at this time" about any trade talk, however, the Texans are in need of help at wide receiver. Additionally, if Arizona pulls off a trade with Houston, it would reunite Harrison with his college quarterback, C.J. Stroud.

Harrison has become an afterthought in the Cardinals' moribund offense, but his mostly uninspired play and inability to make routine catches or create separation have an equal role in the failed relationship. Will a reset prove fruitful — and where is he headed?

Could Buffalo hold the key to his next opportunity? The Bills have several injury concerns in the wide receivers room, namely to DJ Moore (AC-joint sprain), but Joshua Palmer (shoulder) also popped up on the injury report this week and will miss Week 5, per Sal Capaccio . Also of note is the fact that Keon Coleman has dealt with an ankle injury (though he's managed to play through it).

Considering that alone, One Bills Drive has almost certainly called about Harrison — that's what president of football operations/general manager Brandon Beane has told us he does with any intriguing player. If Harrison has struggled to succeed in Arizona, is the risk worth it weight in any potential trade? Many would say yes simply because he's the son of Pro Football Hall of Fame wide receiver Marvin Harrison.

Harrison entered the 2024 NFL Draft as a can't-miss prospect with generational talent. The results have proven less than stunning, but many wonder if he just needs a generational talent at quarterback to get him better footballs. Quarterback Josh Allen fits the bill.

What role would Harrison play in Buffalo is perhaps the better question. Adding Harrison probably means parting ways with someone currently on the roster, such as Palmer or Coleman. That carries risk as both Palmer and Coleman have built chemistry within the system, and both have been more productive in 2026.

It's unlikely the Cardinals receive a significant and early first-round pick for Harrison. His stock has never been lower, and NFL execs aren't in the habit of digging deep into their resources for what amounts to a reclamation project at this point in time.

articles.title: Browns’ Young Receivers Turning Heads as Denzel Boston Earns Superstar Praise
articles.summary: The Cleveland Browns have found themselves on a three-game winning streak, and their young receivers are giving the offense a fresh look. Denzel Boston has b...
articles.body:
The Cleveland Browns have found themselves on a three-game winning streak, and their young receivers are giving the offense a fresh look. Denzel Boston has been the biggest surprise, making explosive plays despite being a second-round pick. KC Concepcion is also part of the picture, giving the Browns another young option to build around. The early results have caught attention, including from people who know what top-level receiver play looks like.

That praise is growing after a strong opening month; however, Boston is not treating four games as proof that he has made it. The rookie has a different priority: keep producing and help Cleveland win.

Denzel Boston Earns Superstar Praise as Cleveland Browns' Young Receivers Shine

On October 9, 92.3 The Fan shared analyst Nathan Zegura's assessment of Boston during a discussion with Ken Carman and Anthony Lima . Zegura did not hold back, describing the Browns' rookie as someone who is already looking like a superstar. The reaction follows a start that has put Boston among the NFL's most productive receivers.

"Denzel Boston is looking like a legit superstar."

With four games in the bag, Boston has tallied 13 receptions for 284 yards and two touchdowns. This yard total is good for 11th place in the league among wide receivers and tops all the rookie players, based on statistics provided by BrownsNation on October 9. With an average of 21.8 yards per catch, Boston can show how quickly he can turn the tide of the game with few chances.

It seems the rookie stats are not based on a single game. He started his NFL career with a 46- yard touchdown reception against the Jacksonville Jaguars, followed by another 55-yard touchdown catch against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. In his most recent game against the Pittsburgh Steelers on October 1, he had four receptions for 89 yards in the Browns' 27-24 victory.

The numbers have made his draft position look less significant. The Browns selected Boston 39th overall after five receivers went in the first round, with teammate KC Concepcion among those chosen ahead of him. Boston had believed his college work at Washington warranted a first-round selection. His early NFL production has given him a chance to answer that disappointment on the field.

That mindset fits a Cleveland team that has won three straight after opening the season with a loss to Jacksonville. Boston has become a major downfield option for Deshaun Watson; however, the Browns also have Concepcion, whose first-round pedigree adds another young playmaker to the passing game.

There has also been recognition from one of Boston's childhood football heroes. After the Browns beat the Steelers, their receiver DK Metcalf told the rookie he was a fan of his game. Boston grew up supporting the Seattle Seahawks and watching Metcalf, making the compliment especially meaningful.

The Browns now head into their October 11 matchup against the New York Jets at 3-1. The 22-year-old's fast start has alr eady put him in the conversation among the league's top rookies.

articles.title: Chiefs get bad news amid latest update on Marvin Harrison Jr. trade destination
articles.summary: This update for the Chiefs likely ends their bid for the Cardinals WR.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs are one of many teams in the NFL that are being linked to wide receiver help in the form of free agent signings like Tyreek Hill and, most recently, a trade for someone like Marvin Harrison Jr.

With reports coming out Saturday morning that the Arizona Cardinals are finalizing a trade involving Harrison, but haven't made the deal official yet, the Chiefs are one of the many teams that could wind up being his landing spot.

However, according to NFL insider Aaron Wilson for KPRC 2 , the Chiefs, alongside the Indianapolis Colts , are reportedly not the landing spot for Harrison amid this reported trade.

Chiefs are reportedly not the Marvin Harrison Jr. trade destination

" Texans involved in ongoing trade discussions regarding Cardinals wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr., per league sources, with 2028 second-round draft pick involved in potential deal," Wilson reports. "Nothing finalized and Cardinals want more teams to bid. Player is aware he will be moved and will be inactive for Lions game. Chiefs and Colts are not trading for Harrison, per sources."

With the Houston Texans seemingly emerging as the landing spot for Harrison, the Chiefs and the Colts are reportedly not going to be his landing spot this season.

Despite the Chiefs looking for wide receiver help, especially after the Tyquan Thornton injury, they do not appear likely to win this bidding war for Harrison.

It's a very interesting situation, with all the reporting suggesting that Harrison is on the move, but no deal is finalized and the team he'll eventually join is not known just yet.

Speculation is running rampant, and the Texans have become the most likely landing spot with all of the reporting suggesting a deal is possible.

For the Chiefs, however, it appears they'll have to pivot elsewhere. Whether it's a trade for another wide receiver or signing someone in free agency, Kansas City seemingly will not be the team to land Harrison in the near future, based on Wilson's report.

This isn't over yet, and the Chiefs could potentially emerge as his landing spot if the Texans, or whichever team is most interested, backs out after Sunday. But, for now, the signs are pointing towards the Chiefs not being the eventual landing spot for Harrison.

articles.title: Congress targets Asad over exclusion of over 9 lakh voters
articles.summary: Congress alleges 9.19 lakh voters were excluded from Hyderabad draft electoral rolls after SIR, questioning AIMIM MP Asaduddin Owaisi’s response.
articles.body: Hyderabad: Congress in-charge for Hyderabad Lok Sabha constituency Mohammed Waliullah Sameer on Saturday said that about 9 lakh of the 23 lakh voters in the constituency had been excluded from the draft electoral rolls during the SIR of electoral rolls.He slammed the AIMIM for making tall claims of protecting all genuine voters, alleging that 9 lakh electors had been placed on the absent, shifted, dead and duplicate (ASDD) list and did not figure in the draft roll published on Aug 17. Sameer said the seven assembly constituencies comprising the Hyderabad Lok Sabha seat — Malakpet, Karwan, Goshamahal, Charminar, Chandrayangutta, Yakutpura and Bahadurpura — had a combined pre-SIR electorate of 23.29 lakh. Of them, 9.19 lakh electors, or about 39.46%, were placed in the ASDD category and did not figure in the draft roll.He said Yakutpura recorded the highest number of exclusions at 1,54,982, followed by Chandrayangutta with 1,48,869 and Malakpet with 1,47,799. Karwan recorded 1,41,766 exclusions, followed by Bahadurpura with 1,21,350, Goshamahal with 1,10,148 and Charminar with 94,174. “AIMIM’s tall claims of helping voters retain their names on electoral rolls during the SIR exercise have fallen flat. AIMIM president and Hyderabad MP Asaduddin Owaisi should come clear on what he is doing about the 9 lakh voters placed on the ASDD list,” Sameer demanded.He said the sharp reduction in the draft electoral roll should have become the single biggest political issue for the sitting Hyderabad MP. “If almost 40% of the electorate in a parliamentary constituency disappears from the draft roll, what could be a bigger issue for its elected MP?” he asked.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Hyderabad | Silver Rate in Hyderabad | Bank Holidays in Hyderabad | Public Holidays in Hyderabad | Hyderabad AQI | Weather in Hyderabad | Petrol Price in Hyderabad | Diesel Price in Hyderabad | CNG Price in Hyderabad | LPG Price in HyderabadStay updated with the latest Hyderabad news. articles.title: Odell Beckham Jr. Reportedly Elevated to Vikings' Active Roster Days After Signing New Contract
articles.summary: The Minnesota Vikings are reportedly elevating wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. from the practice squad to the active roster before their road game at the New Orleans Saints on Sunday, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
articles.body:
The Minnesota Vikings are reportedly elevating wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. from the practice squad to the active roster before their road game at the New Orleans Saints on Sunday, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

The Vikings' top two receivers, Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison, are both questionable for Sunday with ankle and hamstring injuries, respectively.

Minnesota signed Beckham to its practice squad on Wednesday, eight days after the New York Giants released the veteran.

It's unclear if Beckham will actually play, per Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix, but he'll be in position to do so. Minnesota can still make him inactive on Sunday.

Beckham largely dominated the NFL during his first stint with the Giants (2014-2018). He made three Pro Bowls and two All-Pro Second Teams and posted 1,000+ yards in every season except 2017, which ended early due to a fractured left ankle.

The Giants traded Beckham to the Cleveland Browns in 2019. He had another 1,000-yard season but suffered a torn ACL in 2020, ending his season after seven games. Beckham has dealt with numerous injuries since then and has enjoyed only one close-to-full season (2023, with the Baltimore Ravens) this decade.

Beckham showed the Giants enough to make the 53-man roster coming out of training camp.

It didn't work out in New York. Head coach John Harbaugh's team relies heavily on tight ends and has consistently used only three wideouts—Malik Nabers, Malachi Fields, and Darnell Mooney. Beckham saw only one catchless target in limited action with the Giants over three games.

Perhaps he'll get a chance in Minnesota as soon as Sunday. Jefferson and Addison had limited practices Thursday and Friday, so that at least gives hope they'll play.

Teams must submit their inactive list to the NFL 90 minutes before kickoff. The Vikings and Saints kick off Sunday at 1 p.m. ET.

articles.title: Aaron Donald Injury Update, Game Status Revealed by Rams' Sean McVay Ahead of MNF vs. Bills
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Rams will have one of their stars back on defense this week after he missed Week 4 against the Philadelphia Eagles.
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Rams will have one of their stars back on defense this week after he missed Week 4 against the Philadelphia Eagles.

Per ESPN's Sarah Barshop, Rams head coach Sean McVay said that defensive tackle Aaron Donald will play against the Buffalo Bills on Monday despite missing practice on Saturday.

Donald missed the team's season opener in Melbourne as he ramped back up after coming out of retirement, but was on the field for Weeks 2 and 3.

Unfortunately for the Rams and Donald, he had to miss last week's game against the Eagles because of a back injury. McVay didn't offer too many details about Donald's injury, noting that he was "a little bit sore."

"Just taking it a day at a time," McVay told reporters last week. "I wouldn't want to say anything of that nature yet, but I think the back's a little bit sore. And he's as tough as it gets, and so I'll continue to have updates as the week goes."

In his first two games back after two years of retirement, Donald has logged four tackles and one tackle for loss. His production is down quite a bit from what fans are used to, but that is to be expected considering his somewhat limited snap count.

"I don't feel like my wind's off," Donald told reporters on Friday. "I don't feel like I be out there exhausted. I think the way we able to rotate helped me a lot, but I do feel good. Just got to keep going, try to be more productive, do what I need to do."

Even without Donald last week, the Rams improved to 2-2 with a 24-20 win over Philadelphia.

The team is still awaiting the return of star pass rusher Myles Garrett, who was placed on injured reserve after undergoing arthroscopic knee surgery after Week 1. McVay told reporters Saturday that Garrett is not expected to practice next week.

articles.title: Myles Garrett Injury Update, Latest Timeline to Return Revealed by Rams' Sean McVay
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Rams could be without star pass-rusher Myles Garrett for a little while longer.
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Rams could be without star pass-rusher Myles Garrett for a little while longer.

Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters Saturday that Garrett isn't expected to return to practice in the week leading up to an Oct. 18 matchup with the Arizona Cardinals, per Adam Grosbard of the Los Angeles Daily News .

McVay confirmed that Garrett is recovering on track, but it doesn't seem as though he'll be ready to suit up against Arizona.

The seven-time Pro Bowler was placed on injured reserve after undergoing arthroscopic knee surgery following a season-opening loss to the San Francisco 49ers.

The Rams' matchup with the Buffalo Bills on Monday will mark their fourth game since Garrett's IR placement, meaning that he'll be eligible to make his return against the Cardinals.

NFL Network's Ian Rapoport previously reported that Garrett faced a six-week recovery timeline after undergoing the knee procedure, which could also force him to miss a Week 7 game against the Las Vegas Raiders and Week 8 clash with the Los Angeles Chargers.

The two-time Defensive Player of the Year is beginning his first season as a member of the Rams after they acquired him in a blockbuster trade with the Cleveland Browns on June 1.

In 2025, Garrett racked up 60 tackles and 33 tackles for loss while setting a new NFL single-season record with 23 sacks.

He has yet to share the field with Aaron Donald, who came out of retirement to join the Rams once again ahead of his 2026 campaign. Donald missed Week 1 against San Francisco before returning to play in two contests, recording one tackle for loss and one quarterback hit.

Los Angeles sits at 2-2 through four weeks.

articles.title: Travis Kelce-backed $200 million  Six Flags prepares to give ArieForce One a new home amid growing controversies
articles.summary: Six Flags is preparing to bring a fan-favourite roller coaster back to life, but the announcement comes at a challenging time for the amusement park giant.
articles.body: Six Flags is preparing to bring a fan-favourite roller coaster back to life, but the announcement comes at a challenging time for the amusement park giant. ArieForce One, which closed at Fun Spot America Atlanta, will return at a new Six Flags location during the 2028 or 2029 season. The move offers fresh excitement for coaster fans while raising questions about the company's future plans. With Kansas City Chiefs star Travis Kelce serving as a brand ambassador and investor, the relaunch also puts the spotlight on a business facing financial pressure, park sales and serious ride safety concerns.ArieForce One relocation puts Six Flags in the spotlightBuilt by Rocky Mountain Construction, ArieForce One opened in 2023 and quickly attracted thrill-seekers with its intense layout, sharp turns and powerful airtime. Six Flags confirmed the acquisition on September 8, promising to preserve the attraction rather than let its story end with its original closure.The decision gives the company a major attraction to build excitement around, although fans must wait to learn which park will receive it. Six Flags has also confirmed that the coaster will retain its original name.The announcement comes as the company reshapes its park portfolio. Six Flags completed the sale of six US parks to EPR Properties in April 2026 and announced further planned divestments in March. The relocation could help strengthen another property, but its commercial impact will depend on the destination, construction costs and future visitor demand.Travis Kelce's Six Flags investment faces mounting scrutinyKelce's connection to Six Flags extends beyond promotional appearances. In October 2025, he joined activist investor Jana Partners and other executives in an investment group with an economic interest of approximately 9% in the company. Six Flags later named him a brand ambassador in March 2026, giving him a prominent role in its marketing strategy.However, the company's recent challenges have raised concerns. Six Flags reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $865 million, down 7% year over year, while attendance fell 7% to 13.1 million visits. Its net loss also widened to $203 million from $100 million a year earlier.Safety concerns have added another layer of pressure. Six Flags Magic Mountain permanently retired its X2 roller coaster in September after lawsuits alleged serious brain injuries among riders. The claims have drawn attention to ride safety, although allegations do not establish liability.For Kelce and Six Flags, ArieForce One represents an opportunity to create positive momentum. Yet the mystery surrounding its future home is only part of the story. articles.title: NFL reportedly fines Browns QB Deshaun Watson, RB Quinshon Judkins more than $14K for smoking gesture in win over Steelers
articles.summary: Watson and Judkins were among the Cleveland players who participated in the celebratory gesture following a Judkins touchdown in the second quarter.
articles.body:
During a season in which the NFL saw the most accepted penalties through Week 4 since play-by-play data became available in 1978, per ESPN, celebrations have resulted in an array of flags and subsequent fines.

Although the NFL and NFL Players Association released a joint statement this week clarifying that celebrations "imitating drinking a beverage" won't be considered violations, they outlined other gestures that are prohibited and can lead to a 15-yard unsportsmanlike conduct penalty, fine or both.

Those are gestures that depict violence, smoking or drug use or are sexual in nature.

And on Saturday, a report from NFL insider Tom Pelissero surfaced, noting that Cleveland Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson and running back Quinshon Judkins have each been fined more than $14,000 by the league for a smoking gesture during a 27-24 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers on "Thursday Night Football" in Week 4.

The celebration occurred in the aftermath of Judkins' go-ahead 2-yard touchdown run in the second quarter at Cleveland's Huntington Bank Field.

The NFL hit Watson with a $14,926 fine and Judkins with a $14,397 fine, technically for "illegal celebrations and vulgar acts," Pelissero reported for The Ringer and Netflix.

In his report, Pelissero wrote on X that "nothing was obvious on the TV broadcast." Here's the highlight the Browns clipped on social media following the short-yardage score.

But Camryn Justice of News 5 Cleveland WEWS provided footage of the acts in question and reported offensive lineman Austin Barber was also fined $6,944.

According to Justice's report , Judkins received the same fine as Watson, a $14,926 forfeiture.

In the video Justice posted, a jubilant Judkins can be seen mimicking smoking something and then handing it to Barber, who pretended to take a puff before spiking it to the ground.

Judkins repeated the simulation, putting his fingers up to his mouth before giving the fake object to Watson. The 31-year-old QB willingly accepted. Soon after, both Judkins and Watson dropped the theatrics and pumped up the raucous crowd.

Detroit Lions wideout Amon-Ra St. Brown was reportedly fined four times for a smoking gesture he demonstrated during a "TNF" loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 2 .

articles.title: NFL Icon Cris Carter Reveals Advice to Marvin Harrison Jr. Amid NFL Trade Rumors, Texans Links
articles.summary: Pro Football Hall of Famer Cris Carter detailed the advice that he's given to wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. as he deals with his murky future as a member of the Arizona Cardinals.
articles.body:
Pro Football Hall of Famer Cris Carter detailed the advice that he's given to wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. as he deals with his murky future as a member of the Arizona Cardinals.

"I'm constantly in text with Marvin since we talked the first preseason game in Canton," Carter said on the Inside Football podcast (0:19 mark). "So every week I'm sending him certain things. A lot of things that him and I are talking about this year involves self-talk. I said, 'Because you've got a lot of negative talk around you, you're gonna have to offset that and talk to yourself in a positive way and know that you are an elite player and you are a number one guy. You are gonna fulfill your potential. You are a Pro Bowl player. You have as much talent as anyone that's playing the position. You've proven that, you just have to continually prove it over and over again.'"

ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Saturday that the Cardinals were finalizing a trade involving Harrison, although his destination wasn't named.

NFL insider Jordan Schultz later reported the Houston Texans engaged in "deep negotiations" with Arizona regarding the receiver, but the Cardinals were still listening to offers from other teams.

Harrison has struggled to make an impact to start his 2026 campaign, as he's hauled in a mere five receptions for 85 yards and a touchdown through four games.

The lack of production from the No. 4 overall pick in the 2024 NFL draft has been disappointing, especially after he caught 62 passes for 885 yards and eight scores as a rookie.

articles.title: Ex-Panthers, Giants lineman calls out Oregon’s Dan Lanning offense vs. UCLA
articles.summary: Dan Lanning’s Oregon Ducks took on UCLA at Autzen Stadium in a game that included an interception from Dylan Raiola that had fans wishing for Dante Moore. M...
articles.body:
Dan Lanning 's Oregon Ducks took on UCLA at Autzen Stadium in a game that included an interception from Dylan Raiola that had fans wishing for Dante Moore . Moore was considered a first-rounder in the latest NFL Draft projections, as the he hopes to follow in the footsteps of Ducks-turned-pros including former Carolina Panthers lineman Geoff Schwartz.

Schwartz was among those watching Lanning's team stumble to a 10-6 late third quarter deficit, calling out the Dan Lanning and Drew Mehringer-led Ducks offense.

"That was easily the worst half of offense we've played in five years under Lanning," Schwartz said. "Raiola has looked awful. They can't find five OL. They keep rotating guys. I wish I had answers. Everyone has to play better."

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

The Ducks' offense was backed up in its own territory late in the third quarter as Raiola, the former five-star prospect and Nebraska Cornhuskers star, had 43 passing yards and an interception to his name. The Ducks' defense picked him up with two interceptions of Bruins quarterback Nico Iamaleava, but it wasn't enough as the offense failed to capitalize with touchdowns. UCLA had 282 total yards to 89 for the Ducks as the third quarter wound down in Eugene, Oregon, giving Schwartz and fellow Ducks fans the heebie-jeebies as another loss looked possible.

Moore continues to work his way back from concussion symptoms and his return is looking more needed than ever before. Raiola, Lanning and Merhringer continued to take heat as fans wondered whether each member of the Ducks had what it took to turn things around. UCLA is a solid team but far from a national title contender in most fans' eyes, adding to worries. Schwartz echoed what many Ducks fans felt as the game headed toward its inevitable conclusion.
